mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_document ( document_id, document_name, document_type, knowledge_version, source_type, source_name, document_status, enabled, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{documentId}, #{documentName}, #{documentType}, #{knowledgeVersion}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceName}, #{documentStatus}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )

insert into knowledge_fragment ( fragment_id, document_id, goods_id, document_type, knowledge_version, content, rank_no, parent_fragment_id, brother_group_id, brother_index, brother_total, chunk_type, embedding_enabled, fragment_status, enabled, create_time, update_time ) values
( #{fragment.fragmentId}, #{fragment.documentId}, #{fragment.goodsId}, #{fragment.documentType}, #{fragment.knowledgeVersion}, #{fragment.content}, #{fragment.rankNo}, #{fragment.parentFragmentId}, #{fragment.brotherGroupId}, #{fragment.brotherIndex}, #{fragment.brotherTotal}, #{fragment.chunkType}, #{fragment.embeddingEnabled}, #{fragment.fragmentStatus}, #{fragment.enabled}, #{fragment.createTime}, #{fragment.updateTime} )
mapper.select: select document_id, document_name, document_type, knowledge_version, source_type, source_name, document_status, enabled, create_time, update_time from knowledge_document where document_id = #{documentId} limit 1

select fragment_id, document_id, goods_id, document_type, knowledge_version, content, rank_no, parent_fragment_id, brother_group_id, brother_index, brother_total, chunk_type, embedding_enabled, fragment_status, enabled, create_time, update_time from knowledge_fragment where document_id = #{documentId} order by rank_no asc, id asc

select fragment_id, document_id, goods_id, document_type, knowledge_version, content, rank_no, parent_fragment_id, brother_group_id, brother_index, brother_total, chunk_type, embedding_enabled, fragment_status, enabled, create_time, update_time from knowledge_fragment where knowledge_version = #{knowledgeVersion} and enabled = 1 and fragment_status = 'ENABLED' order by document_id asc, rank_no asc, id asc
mapper.update: update knowledge_fragment set fragment_status = #{fragmentStatus}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = now() where document_id = #{documentId}
